 Telangana Revises Ssc Public Examinations 2027 Fee Payment Deadlines 
 Telangana revises SSC Public Examinations 2027 fee payment deadlines
 The Telangana School Education Department has revised the SSC Public Examinations 2027 fee payment schedule. Students can pay without a late fee until November 26, with extended deadlines available for payments carrying late fees of varying amounts.
 By 
 Telangana Today 
 Published Date - 16 November 2026, 12:28 PM 
 Hyderabad: The School Education department on Monday revised due dates for the SSC Public Exams 2027 fee payment.
 The deadline to pay the exams fee without a late fee is November 26. Students can also apply at their respective schools with a late fee of Rs. 50 and Rs.200 up to December 8 and 21 respectively. Applications will also be accepted with a late fee of Rs.500 until January 4, 2027.
 This schedule is applicable to all regular and once-failed students appearing for the SSC, OSSC and Vocational Public Examinations March 2027.
 The fee for more than three or all subjects is Rs.125. Similarly, fee for up to three subjects is Rs.110. In addition to the regular examination fee of Rs.125 for SSC academic courses, vocational students need to pay Rs.60.
